summary: This is a prospectus supplement (424B5) filed by Virtuix Holdings Inc. to amend the exercise price of certain warrants held by Streeterville Capital LLC from $4.00 to $3.00 per share, with the reduced price period expiring July 27, 2026. The filing relates to a resale registration of shares from a direct listing. There is no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other special situation. The filing is a routine disclosure of warrant amendments, not a special-situation event.
